Brazil advances in Copa America after tense match

Brazil secured a victory in their Copa America match, advancing to the next stage. Coach Carlo Ancelotti emphasized patience and tactical adjustments during halftime, noting that creating more scoring opportunities was key. The team's performance was described as having less flair but a stronger survival instinct, drawing comparisons to Real Madrid's resilient style.
